Subject: Request: short-term headroom for latency sweep (Monolith AI POC)

Hi Kimberly,

We're scheduled to run a latency and throughput validation for our Monolith AI POC the week of Feb 22. The team expects peak traffic of ~6k RPS sustained over 4h windows, with average sequence length ~180 tokens and spikes to 800 tokens for a subset of requests. Today's sandbox quota won't cover the soak we need.

Can Redwood provide a temporary credit top-up or trial extension (48–72h window) so we can confirm tail latency under realistic load? Attached is the run plan and expected workload.

Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through details.

Thanks,
Elena Voss
SRE Lead, Monolith AI
(elena@monolith.ai)
Attachment: poc-run-plan.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

Hi Elena — thanks for the run plan.

Short answer: yes, we can usually approve a temporary headroom for POCs. Before I route this to credits, can you confirm:
- Exact run window (start/end in UTC)
- Expected peak RPS and percent of requests at 800-token depths
- Which model(s) you'll target (e.g., gpt-open-10b-q4, redwood-3b-quant)
- Whether you'll need any dedicated slots or just sandbox quota uplift

I'll loop in Marcus (cc'd) for approval and Tessa from Billing for the voucher. If you can reply with the short answers above, I'll push an authorization for a 72-hour buffer and share a tracking link.

Best,
